queries.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL GROUP BY d.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) <= 5

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type,
       d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status,
       d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count
FROM bids_datasets d
LEFT JOIN bids_objects o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND o.subject IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.id
ORDER BY d.name
LIMIT 200

SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p WHERE p.dataset_id = d.id AND p.sex = 'female'))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'participant sex not recorded' WHEN us.u0 = 2 THEN 'participant sex not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p WHERE p.dataset_id = d.id AND p.sex = 'female')) THEN 0 WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS uk WHERE uk.dataset_id = d.id AND uk.sex IS NOT NULL)) THEN 9 ELSE 9 END AS u0
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p WHERE p.dataset_id = d.id AND LOWER(p.sex) IN ('female', 'f')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'participant sex not recorded' WHEN us.u0 = 2 THEN 'participant sex not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
